summary.en: Kogoro and Conan notices that Ran has behave strangely. Kogoro suspects that Shinichi is seducing Ran, and while Conan knows that it can't be the case, they decide to follow her. They see Ran, Sonoko and Masumi who are having some lunch at Café Rice Flower, all the while marvelling at the pictures of a travel guide about a trip to Kyoto. As Ran was going to reveal what was the trip to kyoto, the restaurant's customers and employees hear the sound of Isuzu Naomura yelling. They hurry to the locker room and find Daiki dead.
